zh.title: 私人噴射機是否比客機省油10-15%
zh.summary: 探討私人噴射機高空巡航是否比客機省油10-15%疑問
body: 航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 27 日發布題為「Is It True That Private Jets Burn 10-15% Less Fuel Per Mile By Cruising Above The Airlines?」的文章，提出私人噴射機在高空巡航時是否能比商用客機每英里減少 10% 至 15% 燃油消耗的問題。
文章摘要指出「Why private jets fly so much higher than commercial airliners」，說明私人噴射機選擇更高巡航高度的原因，但未提供具體測試數據或官方證實。

en.title: Do Private Jets Burn 10‑15% Less Fuel Per Mile By Cruising Above Airlines?
en.summary: Article questions whether private jets save 10‑15% fuel per mile by flying higher than airliners
body: Aviation outlet Simple Flying published an article on 27 September 2026 titled “Is It True That Private Jets Burn 10‑15% Less Fuel Per Mile By Cruising Above The Airlines?” which asks whether private jets can achieve a 10‑15% fuel‑per‑mile reduction by flying higher than commercial airliners, framing the issue as an open inquiry rather than a proven fact.

The summary states “Why private jets fly so much higher than commercial airliners,” explaining the operational rationale for private jets to cruise at higher altitudes than scheduled carriers, while the article does not supply measured test results or an official endorsement of the suggested savings.
